text: Mr Ibe opens School. The term is set; no bills are out yet.
He taps Classes, terms and fees, then First term, the current term.
The plan comes first: 396 of 400 students, and the total.
Each class, and who is left out and why, are listed.
Keep as drafts holds the invoices back; nothing is sent.
Or Send now by SMS and email.
He taps Invoice and send 396. Each student is invoiced once.
